title.narrative: CSF 03-21 Year 2 Payment for the Project: Transformed Communities,

description.narrative: The ‘Transformed Communities Brighter Futures’ project in Kericho County, Kenya aims to help women and girls reach their full potential leading to healthier, more resilient and productive lives through access to improved health, education and economic empowerment opportunities, together with implementing partner Brighter Communities Worldwide Kenya. The objectives of the grant are that community members particularly women and girls will have access to a strengthened and more effective and equitable healthcare system, healthier and safer school learning environments for students and teachers, and empowered equitable communities will have the ability to bring about positive change. The key activities include outreach clinics, maternal health task force events, water protection scheme, preparation meeting with Ministry of Health and Ministry of Education, teacher workshops, the construction of latrine and washroom blocks, and the provision of resources to enable beneficiaries to engage in new business opportunities.
